contracts: (The validator source path and content digest have an independently produced pass record; otherwise evaluation remains blocked.) AND (Validator exits success only when both mapping directions contain no unmatched entries and all three named consumer scopes are present.) AND (Validator output contains an approved repository-relative current authority, a deterministic rejection for every user-profile candidate, and no profile path in the selected authority field.) AND (Verification report confirms exactly three required seed occurrences, each unique and complete; any duplicate or missing provenance causes deterministic failure.) AND (added_paths=[] 且 removed_paths=[]，并且每条历史路径按 repository-relative 规范精确相等。) AND (foreign-authority 输入 success_accepted 必须为 false，failure_reason == foreign-authority。) AND (仅当三个 named occurrences 各自唯一、命名正确且显式包含 missing_labels 字段时通过；任一缺失、重复或未命名记录终止为失败。)

Each declared assertion needs a cer_assertion mapping and a meaningful independent oracle. Tests must invoke the real production entry. The plan is not a behavior observation. Keep governance/constraint failures non-authorizing; do not emit expected-red for them. Preserve all bound Given/When/Then and forbidden outcomes. No placeholder pass or synthetic RED.
